Who This Is For

NGOs
Companies
Researchers
Government Programs

Survey exports from KoboToolbox, ODK, Google Forms, or SurveyMonkey rarely arrive analysis‑ready — duplicate submissions, inconsistent coding, open‑ended responses, and skipped logic all need cleaning first.

We take the raw export and deliver a full analysis: response rates, cross‑tabulations, significance testing, and a written summary of what the data actually says about your target population.

What's Included

Data cleaning and duplicate/outlier removal
Coding of open‑ended responses
Cross‑tabulation and subgroup analysis
Significance testing across groups
Charts and summary tables ready for reports
Tools we use:Kobo ToolboxODKSPSSExcelPower BI

How It Works

01

Export Your Data

Send the raw export directly from Kobo, ODK, Google Forms, or your survey tool of choice.

02

Cleaning & Coding

We remove duplicates, handle missing data, and code open‑ended responses.

03

Analysis

We run cross‑tabs, significance tests, and subgroup comparisons aligned to your indicators.

04

Reporting

You receive charts, tables, and a written summary ready to paste into your report or dashboard.

Why Work With Us

Experience with Kobo/ODK exports specific to M&E and field surveys
Handles messy, real‑world data — not just clean textbook datasets
Deliverables formatted for donor and board reports
Fast turnaround for time‑sensitive program reporting

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you work directly with Kobo/ODK exports?

Yes, we regularly clean and analyze exports from both platforms without extra formatting on your end.

Do you handle open‑ended questions?

Yes — we code qualitative responses into analyzable categories or provide thematic summaries.

Can you compare results across regions or demographics?

Yes, subgroup and cross‑tabulation analysis is a core part of this service.

Do you also design the survey itself?

Survey design falls under our Research Methodology Consulting service — we can support both.
